sentences: This maebyeong swells generously at the shoulder and narrows elegantly at the waist, and its surface is filled with cranes flying through clouds.
The design is not painted: the potter carved it into the clay, filled the grooves with white and red-brown slip, and fired it again.
This inlay technique, perfected by Goryeo potters, gives the motifs a depth that seems to float up beneath the jade-green glaze.
Cranes inside the circles fly upward while those outside seem to descend, so the sky moves as you turn the vessel.
It is also famous because collector Jeon Hyeong-pil paid the price of dozens of tiled houses in the 1930s to keep it from leaving Korea.
